sloka: एतत्ते देवि सदृशं पत्न्यास्तस्य महात्मनः ।का ह्यन्या त्वामृते देवि ब्रूयाद्वचनमीदृशम् ।। ५.३८.५।।।।
transliteration: etatte devi sadṛśaṁ patnyāstasya mahātmanaḥ ।kā hyanyā tvāmṛte devi brūyādvacanamīdṛśam ।। 5.38.5।।।।

translations.english: "O humble lady the second reason given by you, 'I ought not to touch a person other than Rama' is well said and worthy of you, being the wife of the great soul. Who else can speak such words?
